answers_open.title: Why does the probe skip on a cold cache?
answers_open.body: The probe gates on a warm session cache, so a cold start reports stale until the first tick refreshes it.

answers_answered.title: Can the answers route coexist with the native flip?
answers_answered.body: Yes. The delegate calls buildAnswers until #1050 retargets or retires the export.

answers_open.title: What does the ask-form do while a POST is pending?
answers_open.body: Further submits are a no-op so a second request never races the first (#292).

answers_answered.title: Is an ask draft kept across surface destruction?
answers_answered.body: DraftStore keeps it until a durable success clears it, so an interrupted ask is not lost (#459).
